ucf_crime_official_videos.access_method: Direct download from official CRCV UCF project distribution
ucf_crime_official_videos.terms_basis: Owner-confirmed official CRCV download; non-commercial research use only; third-party surveillance footage rights remain qualified.
ucf_crime_official_videos.approved_project_use: Internal non-commercial academic research and research paper preparation
ucf_crime_official_videos.redistribution: Raw video media, video clips, and frame crops are not redistributed.

decision: The project is authorized to use the 1,950 official UCF-Crime MP4 video corpus internally for non-commercial academic research and paper evaluation under D-34. Raw media and derived crops remain non-redistributable.
